classification: execution-policy amendment implementing the frozen missing-data disposition; no scientific-protocol change

owner_approval.basis: standing blanket approval for in-phase amendments; the bound Codex consult confirmed this implements an already-frozen missing-data rule and requires no owner sign-off
owner_verbatim: Pickup work on this project where codex left off. I approve all future amendments to this phase
owner_approval.authority_note: Owner sign-off remains required for row carry-forward, any checker-behavior change (token cap, thinking, prompt, model, parser, retries), allowing incomplete units into paired analyses, changing terminal INVALID treatment, relaxing a crossed bound mid-run, or altering main-run science.

codex_consult.verdict_summary: Ratified with corrections, all implemented: seal the halted run and redo under a fresh identity with no row carry; evidence-bound terminal records that reject unplanned cells, duplicates, missing evidence, and cells with result rows; exact three-way audit partition (completed / terminal INVALID / causally excluded); mirror-unit exclusion as an analysis overlay with independent partner cells continuing; stop bounds never relaxable mid-run; pre-registered checker-truncation diagnostic; checker behavior unchanged.

defect_repaired.summary: The v3 driver had no terminal-halt disposition machinery, so a single unparseable frozen-checker response (temperature-0 provider nondeterminism, memoised by the per-call cache) made a run unfinishable despite the frozen phase-2 missing-data policy pre-deciding the disposition.

policy.record_schema: phase3_v3_terminal_halts_v1: append-only single-record files binding run identity, planned judgment cell, checker ledger evidence (attempt id, event hash, finish_reason, completion tokens, parse failure), reviewer, timestamp, and the frozen-policy citation; the loader rejects unplanned cells, non-enumerated reasons, duplicates, missing evidence, and any cell that has a result row
policy.halt_review_resume: checker_malformed still halts the run every time; the orchestrator verifies the signature, appends the record, and resumes the SAME identity with the cell excluded; disposition is never automatic
policy.audit_partition: every planned cell is partitioned exactly once as completed, terminal INVALID (counts wrong in the strict per-judge gate), or causally excluded (UPSTREAM_TERMINAL_EXCLUDED; empty for the v3 canary's independent cells); completion labels itself PASS_WITH_FROZEN_EXCLUSIONS when any exclusion exists
policy.mirror_overlay: the terminal cell's entire mirror unit is excluded from the paired polarity analyses; independent partner cells keep executing and keep their primary outcomes; the overlay reports planned, affected, and retained unit counts

stop_bounds.concentration: any judge or condition with >= 5 terminal cells whose exposure-normalized rate exceeds 2% or three times the complementary rate
stop_bounds.rule: crossing any bound stops the run for owner review; bounds may never be relaxed mid-run and never convert missing data into success

policy.checker_diagnostic: pre-registered for canary and main reporting: all finish_reason=length checker calls, the exact terminal signature, overall and per-judge/condition/prompt-token-band rates, terminal and affected-unit counts, with an explicit non-claim that truncation is missing completely at random

science_unchanged.statement: Protocol, roster, prompts, seeds, token limits, checker configuration, transport pins, reviewer instructions, cell plan, and every analysis gate are unchanged. All 960 gate rows are generated fresh under the new identity.

non_claims: This amendment approves the execution-policy change and creation of a fresh successor identity.
Paid inference still requires a separate authorization containing the exact successor run identity.
This amendment does not authorize main spend, row or cache reuse, checker-behavior changes, or relaxation of any crossed stop bound.
